title: Red Book
description: Less prep for the GM, in one window with a native Foundry look (light and dark). A session dashboard that logs the game as you play (scenes, combats, downs, rests, loot, time, journals shown, NPCs met, level-ups and quick notes), with a filterable timeline, who's at the table (live hit points on dnd5e), a summary and a player recap you review first; a three-column next-session board; a read-only scene readiness check; Session Start (pick the scene, activate, unpause, start the log); a Who's online panel on Hub scenes; quest progress and journeys from the companion toolkit in the log; a prep list fed by the scene check; a "Previously on…" card for players, NPCs met, a session timer with an optional break reminder, attendance with experience or milestones, what the party gained each session, and dates on every log line (sessions that run past midnight); and optional Discord posts (off by default). Every tool can be turned off. Works with any system; extra support for dnd5e.

recommends.reason: Its quests feed the next-session board, and its quests, travel, flights and loot rolls are logged in the session log. Its map pins are left out of the scene check.
A GM hub for your modules: Red Book registers itself there (control panel, health check, debug logging).
